task_text: Prepare hot water for shower and put toilet paper in the trash

central_instructions.R1: Prepare the hot water for the shower by pouring water into the shower system.
central_instructions.R2: Pick up the toilet paper and pass it to R3 for disposal.
central_instructions.R3: Receive the toilet paper from R2 and put it in the trash.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R1 in preparing the hot water for the shower if needed.
